o.text:
From Middle Mongol ᠬᠠᠳᠠᠭᠠ (qadaɣa), ᠬᠠᠳᠠᠭᠠᠯᠠ (qadaɣala), itself a borrowing from Turkic, compare Old Turkic [script needed] (qadaɣla, “to guard, protect”), a derivation of Old Turkic [script needed] (qadaɣ). Possibly ultimately a derivation of Proto-Turkic *kād-, whence also Azerbaijani qayğı (“care”).
Cognate with Turkish kadağa. Compare Persian قدغن, Georgian ყადაღა (q̇adaɣa), Northern Kurdish qedexe, Turkic borrowings.
From English political correctness. Compare Turkish siyasi doğruculuk.
From Persian مزه (whence English meze). Sense 2 perhaps under the influence of məzhəkə.
Calque of Persian پناه بردن (panâh bordan, literally “carry refuge”).
